repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true))
    triggered = false
}
wait until((#Hall_Motion).motionSensor_motion == true)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(100, 0)
delay(3 SEC)
(#Hall_Light).light_moveToBrightness(0, 0)
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait followed by actions. The candidate polls the sensor at the start of the cycle (t=0) and fails to trigger when motion starts at t=100ms because the condition is only checked at body-start instants. The fix implements the rising-edge pattern using blocking waits to detect the transition from false to true.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced periodic polling with a rising-edge state machine: wait until motion becomes true (after ensuring it was previously false), then execute the body. This preserves the IR's requirement that the light turns on exactly when motion transitions to true, not just when the cycle starts.
